id.description: A unique identifier for the article

name.description: The name or title of the article

content.description: The content of the article in markdown format

knowledge_source_id.description: The id of the `knowledge_source` the article belongs to

tag_ids.description: A list of ids for the tags associated with the article

language.description: The IETF BCP 47 language code for the article, defaults to `en`

external_created.description: The date the article was created in the source system

external_updated.description: The date the article was last updated in the source system

enabled.description: Whether the article should be referenced during response generation, defaults to `true`

metadata.description: A dictionary of arbitrary key,value pairs.                     This data is not used by Ada, but can be used by the client to store additional information about                     the article.

availability_rules.description: Availability rule controlling which articles the AI Agent can access during a conversation. Send a rule object to attach or replace a rule, `null` to detach an existing rule, or omit the field to leave any existing rule unchanged. A rule may contain at most 1000 conditions in total. See [Availability rules](/reference/introduction/availability-rules) for the full schema and examples.

match.description: Whether all conditions must pass (`all`) or any one condition must pass (`any`).

conditions.description: List of conditions or condition groups. Must contain at least one entry. Each entry is either a `Condition` object (with `variable`, `operator`, and optional `value`) or a `ConditionGroup` object (with its own `match` and nested `conditions` list).

AvailabilityRule.description: A two-level tree of conditions that determines availability based on variable values during a conversation. The root group has a `match` combinator and a list of conditions or condition groups. A rule may contain at most 1000 conditions in total, counting every condition across the root and all nested condition groups.
AvailabilityRule.title: AvailabilityRule

variable.description: The variable to test, referenced by `id`. Look up the ids for your Agent through the variables endpoint. Not every variable can be used in a rule; referencing one that can't returns a `400`.

operator.description: The comparison operator. Unary operators (`is_set`, `is_not_set`) must not include a `value` field.

value.description: The value to compare against. Omit for unary operators (`is_set`, `is_not_set`).

case_sensitive.description: Whether the comparison is case-sensitive. Defaults to `false`. Only meaningful for the equality (`equals`, `does_not_equal`) and string (`starts_with`, `ends_with`, `contains`, `does_not_contain`) operators. Omitted from responses when `false`.

AvailabilityRuleCondition.description: A single condition comparing a variable to a value.
AvailabilityRuleCondition.title: AvailabilityRuleCondition

match.description: Whether all conditions must pass (`all`) or any one condition must pass (`any`).

conditions.description: List of conditions inside this condition group. Must contain at least one entry.

AvailabilityRuleConditionGroup.description: A nested group of conditions inside a rule's top-level `conditions` list. Condition groups may contain only `Condition` objects — further nesting is not supported.
AvailabilityRuleConditionGroup.title: AvailabilityRuleConditionGroup

AvailabilityRuleConditionGroupMatch.description: Whether all conditions must pass (`all`) or any one condition must pass (`any`).
AvailabilityRuleConditionGroupMatch.title: AvailabilityRuleConditionGroupMatch

AvailabilityRuleConditionOperator.description: The comparison operator. Unary operators (`is_set`, `is_not_set`) must not include a `value` field.
AvailabilityRuleConditionOperator.title: AvailabilityRuleConditionOperator

AvailabilityRuleConditionValue.description: The value to compare against. Omit for unary operators (`is_set`, `is_not_set`).
AvailabilityRuleConditionValue.title: AvailabilityRuleConditionValue

AvailabilityRuleConditionVariable.description: The variable to test, referenced by `id`. Look up the ids for your Agent through the variables endpoint. Not every variable can be used in a rule; referencing one that can't returns a `400`.
AvailabilityRuleConditionVariable.title: AvailabilityRuleConditionVariable

AvailabilityRuleMatch.description: Whether all conditions must pass (`all`) or any one condition must pass (`any`).
AvailabilityRuleMatch.title: AvailabilityRuleMatch

KnowledgeArticleUpsertRequestMetadata.description: A dictionary of arbitrary key,value pairs.                     This data is not used by Ada, but can be used by the client to store additional information about                     the article.
KnowledgeArticleUpsertRequestMetadata.title: KnowledgeArticleUpsertRequestMetadata
